# EPMAPS Mobile Water Meter Reader — implementation tracker

## Current state
- Implemented user stories US-01 through US-08 in the Expo SDK 57 / TypeScript app.
- The app uses Expo Router, Axios, MockAPI resources `MEDIDOR` and `LECTURA`, AsyncStorage, SecureStore, Expo Network, Image Picker, and FileSystem.
- Five compatible demo meters were loaded into the supplied `MEDIDOR` collection and verified. The app also creates any missing demo meter idempotently; it does not delete existing records. `LECTURA` is accessible and ready to receive app records.
- Practice login is intentionally hardcoded as `DEMO-001` / `1234`. It is demo-only and not suitable for production authentication.
- Cloudinary uploads use the public cloud name and unsigned upload preset in `src/constants/config.ts`. No API key or secret is embedded. Photos are copied to durable app documents storage and remain queued locally if upload/sync fails.
- Both anomalous consumption (> 3× average) and damaged-meter reports require a photo; anomalies also require explicit confirmation.
- Removed the unused Expo starter Explore screen. The native APK has not been built.

## Implemented changes
- `src/app/_layout.tsx`: app state provider, Expo Router stack, and authenticated route protection.
- `src/app/index.tsx`, `src/app/meter.tsx`, `src/app/reading.tsx`, `src/app/records.tsx`: Spanish Bento UI for login/dashboard, strict meter-code lookup, recoverable three-step reading wizard, and pending/sent record management.
- `src/context/app-context.tsx`: persistent session, live connectivity, cache refresh, crash recovery, offline queue, sync retries, remote conflict checks, and duplicate protection.
- `src/services/api.ts`: Axios-only MockAPI access, typed payload validation, and idempotent demo meter creation.
- `src/services/storage.ts`, `src/services/photo-storage.ts`: secure session storage, persistent app cache/drafts, and durable local photo copies.
- `src/services/cloudinary.ts`: unsigned Cloudinary photo upload; only the photo URL is sent with the reading record.
- `src/constants/config.ts`, `src/types/domain.ts`, `src/utils/reading.ts`: endpoint/demo configuration, domain types, and validation/date helpers.
- `src/components/app-shell.tsx`, `src/components/bento-card.tsx`, `src/components/form-controls.tsx`: shared status/navigation and Bento UI components.
- `src/types/styles.d.ts`: CSS module declarations required by the existing Expo starter imports under TypeScript 6.
- `app.json`: camera/photo picker and SecureStore plugins; blocks the unused Android microphone permission.
- `package.json` / `package-lock.json`: approved Expo/Axios dependencies. `eslint.config.js` and ESLint dev dependencies were generated by the repository's `npm run lint` setup.
- `README.md`: setup, demo credentials, MockAPI schema, Cloudinary unsigned upload, and native-build notes.
- `.github/Tareas/task_breakdown_for_multiple_agents.md`: completed implementation tasks marked; APK build remains open.

## Story implementation
- **US-01:** Bento login, practice employee/PIN validation, persistent session, and explicit logout.
- **US-02:** Exact uppercase `MED-` plus six-digit validation before any meter lookup.
- **US-03:** Cached meter details and local reading capture when offline.
- **US-04:** Normal, inaccessible, and damaged validations, including required reasons/descriptions.
- **US-05:** Consumption warning, confirmation, camera capture, persistent local photo backup, and Cloudinary upload/retry.
- **US-06:** Draft wizard state persisted across restarts with resume/discard actions.
- **US-07:** Connection/pending indicators throughout the UI and automatic sync on connectivity/foreground transitions with duplicate/conflict checks.
- **US-08:** Pending readings can be edited; sent readings are locked; a meter cannot be submitted twice in the same month.
